final_reason: It has the lowest trajectory-level validation error, and prior alternating, PRBS, and double-pulse forecasts were accurate. Alternatives are close, but clock and saturation variants do not improve validation.

Multiscale memory has the lowest trajectory-level CV error among the non-clock candidates and strong performance across interventions. Memory_clock’s tiny advantage is insufficient evidence for an independent clock; residual lag correlation leaves some uncertainty.
memory_fast has the lowest trajectory-held-out error. The state model’s residual lag-1 correlation suggests remaining temporal dependence, though prior intervention forecast errors were low.
